texts.zh:
为了解决[pickup_planet.owner.GetName]的麻烦，一批我们同意负责转移的罪犯搭着运输船已经登上方舟。我们正尽最大努力安全地安置他们，但如此庞大数量的囚犯迟早会惹出麻烦。

我们的合同为我们提供了处理他们的多种选择，但我们不能把他们再次丢在属于[pickup_planet.owner.GetName]的星球上。同时，其他帝国很可能也不会喜欢他们的某个殖民地突然涌入大量罪犯。当然，如果我们做得足够隐秘，他们可能永远都不会发现我们到底做了什么。
texts.en:
Transport ships carrying the criminals that we have accepted to transfer on behalf of the [pickup_planet.owner.GetName] have boarded the arkship. We are doing our best to safely process them, but such a vast amount of prisoners is bound to create trouble at one point or another.

Our Contract gives us options on how to handle them, but we are not supposed to drop them off again on a world belonging to the [pickup_planet.owner.GetName]. At the same time, it is likely that other empires will not appreciate a sudden influx of criminals in one of their colonies. Of course, if we are discreet enough, they might never realize what we've been up to.

label.zh: 我们会把他们送到别的地方。
label.en: We'll drop them off somewhere else.

tooltips.zh: 解锁囚犯移交方舟舰指令。
tooltips.en: Unlocks the Prisoner Drop-off Arkship Action.

texts.zh: 作为我们合约的一部分，最后一批囚犯已经卸客。我们已尽力保持谨慎，但总是存在被发现的风险，且人们在面对突然涌入的外星罪犯时，很少会感到愉快。
texts.en: The last prisoners carried as part of our contract have been disembarked. We have tried our best to remain discreet, but detection is always a risk, and people are rarely pleased when faced with a sudden influx of xeno criminals.

tooltips.zh: 罪犯£pop£ 人口被转移至[From.GetName]
tooltips.en: The Criminal £pop£ Pops are transferred to [From.GetName]

texts.zh: 我们参与运输罪犯人口的消息尚未传开。看来我们还没有被发现。
texts.en: Word of our involvement in the transport of criminal pops has yet to spread. It seems we have not been detected.

texts.zh: 我们试图欺骗[prisoner_disposal_issuer.GetName]，但是失败了。虽然罪犯已成功卸载，但我们的行动已被发现，[prisoner_disposal_issuer.GetName]已取消合约并拒绝向我们支付报酬。
texts.en: Our attempt at double crossing the [prisoner_disposal_issuer.GetName] has failed. While the criminals have been successfully disembarked, we have been detected and the [prisoner_disposal_issuer.GetName] has cancelled the contract and refuse to pay us.

texts.zh: 虽然我们的行动已被发现，但[prisoner_disposal_issuer.GetName]依然很高兴我们帮他们处理掉了罪犯，并同意向我们全额支付报酬。
texts.en: While we have been detected, the [prisoner_disposal_issuer.GetName] is still pleased that we rid them of their criminals, and have agreed to pay us in full.

summary.text:
# 囚犯登舰 / Prisoners Embarked

- 分类 Category: C8 银河轶事 / C8 Galactic miscellany · 来源 Sources: events/nomads_events_1.txt:11756-12218; common/missions/missions/02_contracts.txt; common/on_actions/00_on_actions.txt:1086-1092 · DLC: Nomads · 审阅 Reviewed 2026-10-12

## 如何开始 How it starts

游牧帝国承接合约 contract_prisoner_disposal（common/missions/missions/02_contracts.txt），方舟舰到达指定星系时触发。

A nomadic empire accepts the contract_prisoner_disposal contract (common/missions/missions/02_contracts.txt); events fire when its arkship reaches the flagged systems.

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

游牧方承接“囚犯处置”合约：在接人星球收到3050，决定如何处置囚犯；在别处放下囚犯时（on_arkship_drop_off_prisoners → 3051）收到“囚犯离舰”3052，一天后“离舰报告”3053。

The nomad takes a prisoner disposal contract: at the pickup world it gets 3050 and decides how to handle the prisoners; dropping them off elsewhere (on_arkship_drop_off_prisoners -> 3051) gives Prisoners Disembarked 3052, and a day later the Disembarkment Report 3053.

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

3050 的选项取决于是否奴隶制；3053 按是否被合约方或他国察觉分三种结果。

3050's options depend on slavery; 3053 has three results by whether the issuer or others detected it.

## 条件与文明差异 Conditions and variants

本导读未单列条件差异；条件随各事件在上文说明，阅读器按文明设定显示可能的版本。/ This guide does not list conditions separately; they are described with each event above, and the reader shows the possible variants for the chosen empire profile.
